attachments.text:
*Feature already in Vim?*

No

*Feature description*

It's been brought up <https://github.com/euclidianAce/ltreesitter/discussions/3|here> to use (my) <https://github.com/euclidianAce/ltreesitter|ltreesitter> in neovim instead of the existing api. This was a while ago so I'm opening an issue to see if that's still on the table.

I've been recently making ltreesitter more usable from the C-side of things so maybe that could be useful to neovim, as well as focusing an effort on one set of tree-sitter bindings for Lua. Additionally, ltreesitter already has documentation generation that could easily be adapted to vim help docs.

I'm decently proficient with both C and Lua and would be glad to help in any way, including sketching out an initial pr to replicate neovim's existing `vim.treesitter` module but with `ltreesitter` under the hood.

cc <https://github.com/vigoux|@vigoux>
